0022600001.text: Detroit hosts Boston in a game that marks the first of the 2026-27 season for both teams, and the Pistons' season opener comes at home. The Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, most recently beating the Celtics 104-103 in Detroit on January 19, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Detroit a 50% chance to win. Nine Celtics players are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions: Derrick White (rest), Devin Carter (illness), Jayson Tatum (rest), Mike Conley (rest), Mitchell Robinson (rest), Neemias Queta (rest), Paul George (rest), Payton Pritchard (rest), and Sam Hauser (rest).
